[[Katurin Ehmbolem]] is an actress found in [[Resplendent Makuun]] just outside the portal to [[Bokka Amphitheatre]]. She stands near [[Brihan Chahu]], and will often be found clapping.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I love the theatre. Anything is possible on stage. A pauper becomes a queen. An awkward school girl flowers into a magnificent dancer. Nothing on stage is ordinary...and neither am I."''

==Quotes==
:''"I'm an actress, dear, not a tour guide. Move along."''
:''"If you can imagine, you can inspire. Especially on stage."''
